data.long_meaning: Prafulla means 'full of light', 'brimming with wisdom', and 'beauty in abundance'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'prabhā', which means 'brightness, light'. The name is often given to babies born during the winter solstice, when the sun is at its brightest. The name Prafull carries the meaning “Full of light” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Prafull usually hope their child will grow to embody full of light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Prafull symbolizes enlightenment and the pursuit of knowledge. It is a name for those who seek to illuminate the world around them with their wisdom and understanding.
data.etymology: Prafull belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Full of light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Prafull total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
